item.title: Border 2 Worldwide Box Office: Sunny Deol, Varun Dhawan, Diljit Dosanjh, & Ahan Shetty starrer clocks Rs 400 crore globally in 14 days
item.description: Border 2, starring Sunny Deol, Varun Dhawan, Diljit Dosanjh, and Ahan Shetty, is doing well at the box office. The military drama crossed the Rs. 400 crore gross mark at the worldwide box office in its 14 days of theatrical run. It fetched around Rs. 347 crore gross from the domestic markets while the overseas territories contributed a sum of USD 6.25 million, which is around Rs 57 crore gross. Though war based films don't do well generally, the movie still managed to put up an impressive total.

item.title: Vadh 2 Box Office Collections 1st weekend: Sanjay Mishra, Neena Gupta film records reasonable trend, nets Rs 2.25 crore in 3 days
item.description: Vadh 2, directed by Jaspal Singh Sandhu, and starring Sanjay Mishra and Neena Gupta in the lead roles, is holding decently at the box office. item.description: Border 2 collected Rs. 6.75 crore nett approx on its third Sunday, with which it wrapped its third weekend at Rs. 14.50 crore nett approx.
